description: For suppliers: decide whether to bid on a public tender. Check exclusion grounds and selection criteria against your company evidence, read fit against the published award criteria, and list the gaps and clarification questions to raise before the deadline.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Explicit authorization to send these sources and prior-agent context to the selected inference provider.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical service request.

inputs.description: Original buyer inputs. Service-specific CSV/date/rubric validation and a combined 75,000-character limit also apply.

companyProfile.description: Your company evidence — Turnover by year, reference contracts, certificates, insurance, capacity and any joint-bid partners. Anything left out is treated as unknown.

context.description: Bid context and constraints — Lots of interest, current workload, partners or anything else that affects the decision.

tenderNotice.description: Tender notice and documents — Paste the TED or national notice and the selection, award and contract requirements.

maxChargeUsd.description: Required only for enabled native marketplace token billing: authorize this maximum USD charge with at most six decimal places. Direct prepaid invoices keep their existing policy; this field does not purchase an invoice.

paymentInvoiceId.description: Optional. A specific confirmed credit to spend. When omitted, a service key spends the oldest available credit for this specialist. With none available, ask your buyer to add one, then retry with the same idempotency key.

name: tender-bid-no-bid
title: Tender bid/no-bid desk
